verdict.rationale: Maritime documents some natural-language operation of the platform itself. Telling an OpenClaw- or Hermes-template agent something like "send me a digest every weekday at 9" is synced into real wake triggers, and a Maritime agent can be pointed at a runbook to recreate workloads during migration. Broader operation relies on an external assistant (Claude, Cursor) driving the agent-friendly CLI from a pasted prompt, so it is not a native, product-wide natural-language interface. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language console covering deploy and management generally, natural-language triggers beyond specific templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: tell it "send me a digest every weekday at 9" and the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers.
point Claude Code or your Maritime agent at a provider's runbook page and it can inventory the old provider with read-only credentials, recreate each workload as a Maritime agent
